pages.title: Shell
pages.text: Shell Moon only. A dome that stops every projectile, both ways.

$(l)Crouch$() and $(l)hold$() $(k:ecmoons.moon_ability). After 2 seconds of charging without moving, a dome of radius 3 rises around you for up to 6 seconds.$(br2)It collapses when you let go, stand up, move, when it runs out or breaks.
pages.title: How it works

pages.text: $(l)Projectiles$() can't cross it in either direction: arrows, tridents, potions, pearls, fireballs, snowballs and fireworks. Arrows and tridents drop as items at the edge. Nothing splashes, teleports or explodes past it.$(br2)$(l)Durability:$() 100. Each projectile costs 10, explosive ones 30.

Players inside take $(l)75% less$() explosion damage.$(br2)$(l)Not blocked:$() people and mobs can walk in and out, and melee works as normal. Shells can't overlap.$(br2)$(l)Cooldown:$() 20 seconds after it collapses. You can't raise one where you aren't allowed to build (claims and protected areas).$(br2)$(l)Counterplay:$() walk in and fight up close, or wait it out.
